bibliographic.title: The Sound of Flesh on Flesh (An Incomplete Demo)
bibliographic.author: Falcon of Light
bibliographic.description:
(This is a ~20 minute demo, and not a full-game This demo might be expanded on, but only in the far-future. For now, however, I wish to upload this version of it for archiving purposes and for those interested in playing it as a short experience.​)

You are a construction worker tasked with destroying newly flesh-infested buildings. The flesh is relentless, vermin-like, and lonely. Buildings around you have taken the form of flesh like any other living being. Only you, and you, can destroy them all until they are dust. Do not, and the flesh spreads, and eats away at everything around you.
Your task is simple and clean. Ensure the flesh has no place to be at all.
------------------------------------------------------------

*Copyright: Artwork is fully my own. Sounds used are from Google's Sound Library.

*Mobile: Portrait Mode breaks the images within the game and is not suggested. Mobile is not optimal, but supported, and as are touch-controls. Play in Landscape Mode only.
